name: Thompson Chicago
insider_take: This sleek Gold Coast gem puts you steps from Chicago's most exclusive shopping and dining, with Lake Michigan views that'll make you forget you're in the Midwest.
whats_special: Thompson Chicago sits in the heart of the prestigious Gold Coast neighborhood, directly across from the historic Water Tower - one of only seven structures to survive the Great Chicago Fire of 1871. The hotel's rooftop bar offers stunning panoramic views of Lake Michigan and Navy Pier, while being just two blocks from the Magnificent Mile's luxury shopping corridor.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on floors 12+ for unobstructed vistas of Oak Street Beach and Lake Michigan - the sunrise views are absolutely spectacular and worth the upgrade.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you within walking distance of Oak Street Beach (Chicago's most fashionable stretch of sand), the iconic Chicago Architecture Foundation River Cruise departure point, and some of the city's best steakhouses including nearby Gibsons Bar & Steakhouse, a legendary Chicago institution.
pros: Prime Gold Coast location steps from luxury shopping and dining
Sophisticated rooftop bar with stunning city skyline views
Contemporary boutique design with modern amenities
Hyatt Privé program benefits including room upgrades and VIP perks
cons: Premium pricing reflects upscale Gold Coast location
Compact room sizes typical of boutique urban properties
